scope: Original shared-world service rooms. Props use local16x11coordinates; contributor gyms are separate.

dogpatch_room.rest: Long walk? Park your team here. I'll patch them up while you take a seat.
dogpatch_room.shop: I keep the small supplies by the counter. Turns out a repair shop gets a lot of scraped knees.

potrero_hill_room.rest: You can put your bag down. We'll look after your team while you find a quiet chair.
potrero_hill_room.shop: The books are free to borrow. These travel supplies aren't, sadly. I asked.

mission_room.rest: Come in. You don't need a class booked to rest here. Let me help your team first.
mission_room.shop: The travel supplies are on this side. The paint is on the other. Please don't mix them up.

castro_room.rest: Grab a seat. Your team can rest here, and I'll bring some water. No purchase needed.
castro_room.shop: Need supplies for the next stretch? I have the basics. The good gossip is free.

outer_sunset_room.rest: Take a breather out of the wind. I'll get your team ready before you head back to the beach.
outer_sunset_room.shop: Check your bag before you go. I have supplies, but the dry socks are all mine.

marina_room.rest: Water first. Sit down and I'll take care of your team. Your group can survive without you for a minute.
marina_room.shop: Travel supplies? Yep, this counter. The bar tab is somebody else's problem.

pacific_heights_room.rest: Come in, you've done enough stairs. Your team can rest here before you tackle the next hill.
pacific_heights_room.shop: I keep a few supplies for neighbors passing through. Yes, you count. You've already climbed the stairs.

noe_valley_room.rest: Put your team by the repair bench. I'll patch them up. You can take the chair with the least wobble.
noe_valley_room.shop: Need a few supplies? I've got those. If you need a whole new plan, the coffee table is over there.

mission_bay_room.rest: Coming from the waterfront? Have a seat. I'll get your team rested before the next stretch.
mission_bay_room.shop: I keep basic supplies beside the coffee counter. Easy to forget them when you're watching the water.

giants_stadium_room.rest: You found guest services. Rest your team here; you don't need to wait for the seventh inning.
giants_stadium_room.shop: Need supplies before heading back out? I've got the basics. Souvenir prices are at the other counter.

financial_district_room.rest: You can sit here without opening a laptop. Let me get your team rested while you take a break.
financial_district_room.shop: Supplies for the next stretch? Straightforward prices. I promise there isn't a subscription.

north_beach_room.rest: There's a quiet seat here. Rest your team before you head for the islands. The book can wait.
north_beach_room.shop: Check your supplies before you cross the water. Coming back for one item gets old fast.

treasure_island_room.rest: Made it across? Put your bag down. I'll help your team while you warm up inside.
treasure_island_room.shop: Take a look before your next crossing. These are travel supplies; the lost umbrellas aren't for sale.
